column1: # The order of checks of a command and a batch POST /v1/write (P/01.1 N2.1). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose.
# The input of the table is the body already parsed as JSON by N2.1 (HTTP framing, the body limit, RFC 8259, JSON_DEPTH — before the table). Rows in the order of n:

# the first row whose when is true gives the refusal code, kind and the fields fault; none — the command goes on to N3. The table does not read the store state (cas and guard by value, the id memory) — that is N3.
# op — which commands the row applies to: * — all, otherwise a comma list of values of body.op. group — consecutive rows with one group form a group:
# each binds the index and the element of a list (i, w in body.writes), the group applies to the elements in order, element i as a whole before element i + 1; no list — no elements.
# when and fault are CEL (extensions strings, two-var-comprehensions; type(), has(), matches() — standard CEL). Variables:
#var body dyn — the JSON of the body; strings carry U+FFFD instead of a lone surrogate
#var sock string — the caller role at this check, defined once by P/01.2-R017 (spec/01.2-store.norms.md, N3 check)
#var lone list<string> — the JSON Pointer of every string of the body with a lone surrogate; for a field name — the pointer of the object where it stands (N2.1)
#var lim map<string,int> — the parameters of the lesson, only the names of #lim; binding by name, not declaration order (P/01.1-R055)
#lim BATCH_WRITES — P/01.1 N1 batch
#lim BATCH_GUARDS — P/01.1 N1 batch
#lim ROW_CEILING — P/01.1 N1 row.items.ceiling: the row ceiling of the store
#fn key_ok(string) -> bool — the key rules of N1 row.key: not empty, does not start with /, no segment .., at most KEY_BYTES UTF-8 bytes
#fn weight(map) -> int — the weight of items of N1: the sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of all names and values
#fn finite(double) -> bool — finite in binary64 (1e400 is not)

#fn allowed(string, string, string) -> bool — full permission for the effective role, operation read | write | delete and key by P/01.2 N3 «check», including never and admin/internal-role exceptions; not only the ordinary-role file evaluator
# id — the stable address of the row, prefixed wc-, independent of check and the order n; not renamed or renumbered
# check — the refusal name in refusals.tsv; several checks may select the same refusal
n
